stories.title: Connah’s Quay darts academy secures £283,000 funding
stories.summary: A new youth darts and pool academy in Connah’s Quay has been given an incredible boost of almost £283,000 from the Local Growth Fund. stories.summary: Buckley Cricket Club is preparing to bid for Cricket Wales funding for new changing rooms at its pavilion, which the club says was a First World War barracks. stories.title: Council steps in to bridge joint archive’s £1.2m shortfall
stories.summary: A £1.2m funding shortfall in the joint Flintshire and Denbighshire archive project is not expected to hold up the plans after Flintshire agreed to provide an additional £170,000.
